semantic.justification: Iteration228 ports bounded horizontal LTR numbering tab selection from txttab/inftxt: list tab replaces its item position, preceding defaults are removed, lookup is strictly beyond actual glyph advance; next explicit/default stop, tabs-relative origin and hanging/TAB_COMPAT flags retain native arithmetic. Browser glyph advance is measured before paint and refreshed after fonts/resize with transformed device normalization; authored four-field layout, legacy minimum distance, immutable model/history and IO deviations retained. Full RTL/vertical/right-center-decimal/fill/overflow/native portion layout remain partial or unverified; no complete-module promotion.
